business_summary: Yimikang Tech.Group Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells precision air conditioning solutions in China. It provides precision air conditioners equipment, precision computer room air-conditioning, precision clean air-conditioning, precision chillers, precision closed environmental engineering, environmental protection equipment, computer system integration, engineering general contracting business, etc. The company also offers refrigeration equipment, air conditioners, uninterruptible power supplies, batteries and related products, air purifiers, electronic products; provides environmental engineering technology consulting and related engineering services; research and develop, applies and promotes energy-saving technologies. It also provides temperature control equipment manufacturing, system integration, and technical consulting for constant temperature and humidity environments such as data center computer rooms; energy-saving engineering design, construction engineering, technical consulting and technical services; contract energy management; property leasing; property management services; and import and export of goods and technologies. The company was formerly known as Sichuan Yimikang Environmental Tech. Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Yimikang Tech.Group Co., Ltd. in February 2018. Yimikang Tech.Group Co., Ltd. was founded in 2002 and is based in Chengdu, China.
